title: proactive-ID0367393-DC/Si-D/FI-[Jmqcym] - IMD_BC4 & DC1-2_CableTempIssue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Multiple IMD_BC4 failures and multiple DC1-2_CableTempSensor issues last 3 weeks.
Root cause: Faulty IMD and CCS cables
Solution: Replace IMD_BC4 and CCS2 cable DC1 and DC3
NOTE FROM L2: All errors are
(VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)

additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367393-DC/Si-D/FI-[Jmqcym] - IMD_BC4 & DC1-2_CableTempIssue CRM:01282000372
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
For the IMD_BC4 error please check this communication cables:
Starting from the IMD itself:
And ending at the KF11:
Check for any loose cabling
Visual inspection of the cables for damage also.
Check if the XD10.3 is connected properly
Has any sign of damage/faulty terminals.
If you don't find issues with this, do you have any spare cables for this? Or do they only come with a spare full IMD?
For the CableTempSensor error:
DC1 occurred 35 times in the last month:
For me this cable should be replaced.
DC2 occurred 7 times:
For me this one occurred few times in one month. I need the visual inspection of the outlet to see if there are any damages.
For DC3 it happened 17 times over the last month. I think this one is more priority than DC2.
For DC4 it only happened 2 times in the last month = no problem.
In sum:
Please order:
IMD_BC4
3 CCS cables
What is your opinion?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367393-DC/Si-D/FI-[Jmqcym] - IMD_BC4 & DC1-3_CableTempIssue CRM:01282000372
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
A quick update on the CableTempSensor error. From our perspective, I cannot recommend to replace a cable with more than 10 occurrences, this was aligned with Product Champion as it would be massive in costs. First we need to make an assessment of the plug and go from there. It's up to you if you want to take a spare one or not, for the ones that have few occurrences, since (in this case) it occurred few times (for DC2 and DC4). For DC1 and DC3 it's clear to me that we should order a new CCS cable. But we still need to make a visual inspection of the CCS before replacement and make wiring checks.
In sum, from TechSupport:
2 CCS cable
IMD_BC4
Thank you for understanding.
Best regards,
Francisco
